rows.en: －　Corridor　－＝－　Riko and Eiji are fighting　－
＊Eiji＊＠０９７＿０２５C'mon, it's not like I said it￥to be mean or anything.
＊Riko＊＠０９７＿０２６Not meaning it doesn't give you￥the right to say whatever you￥want!＝＠０９７＿０２７Take it back!!
＊Eiji＊＠０９７＿０２８It's just a rumor, geez.￥Quit blowing up over every￥little thing!!
＊Riko＊＠０９８＿００２Not that yelling at you￥will do any good, but...!
＊Riko＊＠０９８＿００３This isn't some fight!＝＠０９８＿００４That guy is going around￥spreading baseless rumors,￥that's what!!
＊Riko＊＠０９８＿００５I was passing by here, and I￥heard Eiji talking to someone...＝＠０９８＿００６And I heard my name in there,￥so I sort of stopped and￥listened in.
＊Riko＊＠０９８＿００８They were saying I only became￥a candidate because of my￥connections!
＊Riko＊＠０９８＿００９Because my father's on Project￥Elan's executive board? Because￥of my family name? That's...
＊Riko＊＠０９８＿０１０That has nothing to do￥with who I am!!
＊Riko＊＠０９８＿０１１Connections...￥As if that could ever be true!
＊Riko＊＠０９８＿０１３Are you saying you could just￥shrug it off if it were you?
＊Riko＊＠０９８＿０１７Why...￥Why are you following me?!＝＠０９８＿０１８Just leave me alone, okay?!
＊Riko＊＠０９８＿０１９Why do you even care?￥If you say it's out of pity...￥I'll knock you flat!!
＊Riko＊＠０９８＿０２０If you're not serious about it,￥then don't bother with me!＝＠０９８＿０２１If you're just curious, leaving￥me alone would be the kinder￥thing!
＊Riko＊＠０９８＿０２２I've... I've been hearing it￥since I was a kid... I'm used to￥that kind of backstabbing talk.
＊Riko＊＠０９８＿０２３Everyone judges me by my family￥name, or my father's power...＝＠０９８＿０２４by things like that, and￥nothing else.
＊Riko＊＠０９８＿０２５No matter how hard I work,￥everyone thinks it's all￥thanks to my family.
＊Riko＊＠０９８＿０２６At times like that, I wonder￥why nobody will look at￥me for who I am.
＊Riko＊＠０９８＿０２７Why won't anyone judge me￥on my own merits, just as￥I am...?
＊Riko＊＠０９８＿０２８Don't play nice with me!! Deep￥down you think the same thing,￥don't you?!
＊Riko＊＠０９８＿０３０Sure, maybe it's not your￥problem, but you're being￥way too flippant!
＊Riko＊＠０９９＿００１We've been training together as￥candidates for months now...＝＠０９９＿００２I thought everyone here￥understood me.
＊Riko＊＠０９９＿００３That I...￥got in here on my own.
＊Riko＊＠０９９＿００４And instead... they thought I￥was the kind of person who'd￥pull strings to get in...
＊Riko＊＠０９９＿００７Make them see it... huh.￥I'm tired of trying to get￥people to understand me.
＊Riko＊＠０９９＿００８But... I was a little relieved￥that you weren't part of all￥that gossip.
＊Riko＊＠０９９＿００９Because I thought that you,￥at least, might believe￥in me...
＊Riko＊＠０９９＿０１０Y-you don't need to thank me￥for anything!!!
＊Riko＊＠０９９＿０１２Why did I end up telling you￥all this? Maybe I'm a￥little tired.
＊Riko＊＠０９９＿０１３Just forget everything we￥talked about today! Got it?!
